integrity: The claim is derived directly from the published SIR vector field, hybrid coupling equation, residual-target definition, and stated componentwise noisy-data preprocessing. The general identities are algebraic. A bundled exact-rational checker replays the projection and error-decomposition identities without using trained network weights.
scientific_limitations: The result establishes a structural conservation condition and an exact projection repair; it does not quantify mass drift in the paper's trained trajectories.
The projection enforces total-population conservation but not compartmentwise nonnegativity.
The non-worsening error theorem is specific to the controlled experiment in which both reference and distorted models have the same closed-population SIR structure.
Real-data epidemic models with demographic fluxes need a different invariant or no fixed-mass constraint.
title: A zero-sum projection restores the conservation law in neural-corrected SIR dynamics
